status: Closed — fixed; identity-remediation safety regressions reverified
area: Commit identity: the facade accepts an identity the hook does not, and its remediation names another actor
finding: Two separate defects in one governed commit refusal. First, git commit --name/--email documents itself as seeding the actor runtime identity profile, but seeding it there does not satisfy the pre-commit attribution check: the same command that reported ATM_GIT_COMMIT_IDENTITY_MISSING accepted --name and --email on the retry, got past the facade, and was then blocked by ATM_COMMIT_IDENTITY_PROFILE_MISSING from the hook. Only a prior identity set --actor call resolved it. Second, the remediation template the hook prints substitutes a hard-coded example identity — git-name "Codex", git-email "codex@openai.local" — into a command that names the blocked actor. Copying the prescribed command verbatim registers the blocked actor under a different agent's name and email, and every commit it then authors is misattributed.
expectedBehavior: A facade option that advertises identity seeding must satisfy the same identity requirement the hook enforces, or must not advertise it. A generated remediation command must contain no identity value the caller did not supply: unknown fields belong in placeholders such as <git-name> and <git-email>, which fail loudly if pasted unedited, rather than in a real identity borrowed from whichever actor happened to seed the template.
evidenceOrRepro: ATM-GOV-0366 delivery commit, 2026-08-13. node atm.mjs git commit --actor claude-008-gov-0366 ... failed ATM_GIT_COMMIT_IDENTITY_MISSING. The retry adding --name "Claude 008" --email "claude-008@atm.local" failed ATM_GIT_COMMIT_FAILED, whose stderr carried the hook's blockingFindings entry ATM_COMMIT_IDENTITY_PROFILE_MISSING with requiredCommand: node atm.mjs identity set --actor "claude-008-gov-0366" --git-name "Codex" --git-email "codex@openai.local" --json. Running identity set with the actor's own name and email, then re-running the identical commit, produced 3baf721bf with the correct governed author.
followUp: Fixed on 2026-09-03: hook and facade remediation now always emit explicit git-name/git-email placeholders, never values read from local git config. Focused facade and hook tests seed a real local identity and prove the returned command still contains only placeholders. The command specification already states that --name/--email seeds identity during git prepare only, so no misleading commit-seeding claim remains. Adjacent to [ATM-BUG-2026-08-13-021] only in that both were found on the same delivery.
